simple.summary: סֶלַע הַמַּחְלְקוֹת (Çelaʻ ham-machlᵉqôwth) means Sela-ham-Machlekoth , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: 1Sam 23 28.

definitions.full: H5555. Sela Hammachleqoth II. מַחְלְקוֺת noun feminine plural smoothness , הַמּ ׳סֶלַע 1Sam 23:28 rock of smoothness , i.e. slippery rock , perhaps original meaning of this proper name, see further I. מחלקוֺת below I. חלק .
definitions.rootNote: from 5553 and the plural of 4256 with the article interposed; rock of the divisions;
